data.name: M_GeneratedNotVerifiable
data.value: Generated, but an entropy source that cannot be re-checked was mixed in, so this result is not reproducible evidence

data.name: M_GeneratedVerifiable
data.value: Generated from a single verifiable source; the same number can be recomputed from that source's published pulse

data.name: M_LockedHint
data.value: The range and entropy sources are locked; clear the lock switch below to change them

data.name: M_NoEntropySource
data.value: Select at least one entropy source

data.name: M_NotVerifiableNotice
data.value: random.org or the local CSPRNG is selected: reproducibility is reduced, so this result only shows that the input produced this number and is not fairness evidence

data.name: M_PageDescription
data.value: Generate one raw random number inside the range (no replacement semantics); with a single verifiable source selected, the number can be recomputed afterwards from that source's published pulse

data.name: M_RangeInvalid
data.value: Invalid range: the lower bound must not exceed the upper bound and both must be whole numbers

data.name: M_Ready
data.value: Set a range and entropy sources, then generate

data.name: M_VerifiableNotice
data.value: One verifiable source is selected: the number can be recomputed afterwards from its published pulse

data.name: M_Locked
data.value: Locked: the range and entropy sources cannot be changed

data.name: M_ProofSavedFormat
data.value: Proof written to {0}; the local recomputation check passed

data.name: M_ProofVerifyFailed
data.value: The number was generated, but the proof failed its own check: do not use this record, and report it together with the log

data.name: M_UnlockCancelled
data.value: Verification was not completed, so the lock stays on

data.name: M_Unlocked
data.value: Unlocked: the range and entropy sources can be changed

data.name: C_ValuesWatermark
data.value: Only these values, e.g. 5,10 (comma or space separated)

data.name: M_ValuesInvalid
data.value: Invalid set: enter at least one whole number

data.name: C_RawEntropy
data.value: Output raw entropy instead of an in-range value

data.name: M_AdvancedHint
data.value: A wider output is not more entropy: everything past the seed is a deterministic expansion, so the usable entropy never exceeds the source's

data.name: M_EntropyFormat
data.value: {0} symbols · {1:F2} bit/symbol · {2:F0} bit total · source cap {3} bit

data.name: C_ExclusionsWatermark
data.value: Excluded from the candidates, e.g. 7,8 or 13-15 (may be empty)

data.name: M_PredicateHint
data.value: The condition has one variable X and supports + - * / %, comparisons and logic; there is no assignment and no loop

data.name: M_ClipboardUnavailable
data.value: The clipboard is unavailable, so nothing was copied

data.name: C_AllowConcat
data.value: Fill a wider output by concatenating several samples

data.name: M_ConcatHint
data.value: Only the local CSPRNG and random.org bring fresh entropy per fetch; repeating inside one beacon pulse does not, so the output gets wider while the measured entropy stays the same
